name: Lenox Apple Orchard
description: Lenox Apple Orchard is a small farm in Dyersburg, TN. It grows Blueberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
